standfirst: Web Summit's Day 2, Wednesday 11 November, does not take place, after the Government of Portugal formally advised it not to because of Storm Charles. IPMA has a red rain warning for the Lisbon district from 09:00 to 18:00; its wind warning was lowered from red to orange on Wednesday morning.

developments.text: IPMA lowered its wind warning for the Lisbon district from red to orange on Wednesday morning (09:00 to 21:00, gusts up to 120 km/h); the red rain warning, 09:00 to 18:00, stands.

Web Summit says Day 2 (Wednesday) will not take place: the Government of Portugal formally advised it not to, after talks with the government, ANEPC and the PSP, and it aims to go ahead with Day 3 on Thursday.
The government's alert situation runs from 00:00 to 23:59 on Wednesday: schools and non-essential public services close, and outdoor events are suspended.

programme.label: Web Summit, Wednesday
programme.text: Day 2 will not take place, on the Portuguese Government's advice. Web Summit aims to proceed with Day 3 on Thursday, after the storm passes.
